name: Cecile Chevalier
source:
Sergeant 1st Class / Mechanic
Nationality: French

Bubbly and cheerful. A brilliant engineer and inventor currently working under the UN's jurisdiction. Her expertise in mechanical engineering and robotics is world renowned. Usually seen arguing with Jennifer.
